title: 1D DP
learn: dp[i] from previous states: take/skip, linear sequences
hook: House Robber, Coin Change, Word Break, Decode Ways and Longest Increasing Subsequence are the core 1D DP set on every interview list. Each one is a choice of what dp[i] means and one line of recurrence.

explain.prompt: Explain the DP solution to Coin Change: the state, the recurrence, the base case, and why greedy doesn't work.
keyPoints: state: dp[a] = fewest coins to make amount a
recurrence: try every coin as the last one: dp[a] = min(dp[a − c] + 1) over coins c ≤ a
base case dp[0] = 0, everything else starts at infinity; unreachable → −1
greedy (biggest coin first) fails for coins like [1, 3, 4] and amount 6
